name: Audacity
description: Gain a stack of Audacity for each successful Basic Attack on any enemy and for each successful damaging ability on Enemy gods. At 10 stacks you gain 100% Attack Speed and Increased Basic Attack Projectile Speed for his next 5 Basic Attacks.

name: So Beautiful
description: Send a projectile forward that deals {Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Physical Damage.

name: Serenade
description:
Sing to Mesmerize all nearby enemies and gain additional protections.

• Any damage done breaks the Mesmerize

name: The Moves
description:
Dash forward dealing {Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Physical Damage and Knocking aside all enemies. At the end of the Dash all nearby allies gain a Speed Buff and all nearby enemies are Slowed.

• Any enemy hit provides 1 stack of Audacity.

name: Across the Sky
description:
Ride your chariot across the sky, choosing when to land. When descending you deal {Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Physical Damage every 0.15s for 0.6s, Knocking back enemies on the last tick.

• 2 Allies can join the Chariot ride by interacting with his takeoff location. Allies have until Apollo reaches max height to join

name: Apollo Basic Attack
description: Fire a projectile that deals {Damage_Formula} Physical Damage to the first enemy hit.
